commit_message: Complete ADR 0122 spatial audio runtime integration
pr_body:
## Summary

Applies the ADR 0122 runtime foundation to current main without replacing the existing engine-owned spatial math or managed backend. Adds authored listener priority and emitter rolloff/loop policy, engine composition/ECS synchronization, listener diagnostics, and generation-checked deferred Project Rust spatial playback while preserving existing 2D PlaySoundEffect semantics.

Editor inspector/gizmo/audition and final ADR Verification are completed by follow-up Dispatcher requests on this same Draft branch before acceptance.
